text:
Ethan: Escalation: HelixMed trial blocked - customer requires data-residency proof (EU-only hosting + DPA signature) before we can create their private deployment. Support opened SUP-10222, customer has renewal review in 6 days -> marking as HIGH priority :rotating_light:
Meera: thanks Ethan. What specifically is missing from our side? Docs? Signed contract?
Ethan: support notes show HelixMed legal wants: 1) signed DPA with EU data residency clause, 2) SOC2 Type II attestation PDF, and 3) confirmation of VPC peering timeline. They wont let the trial proceed until we provide these.
Clara: ok. Two paths: A) fast-track a Dedicated sandbox in eu-west with isolation (can be provisioned in ~48h) to unblock evaluation, or B) provide the docs and schedule Private deployment (will take longer). Which does customer prefer?
Ethan: customer asked for fastest unblock. Theyd accept a dedicated sandbox if we can guarantee no cross-tenant data access and a signed DPA.
Ben: I can swing the DPA signature today if Legal approves the standard EU addendum. Ill ping Legal and loop you. Recommend offering a 30-day Dedicated sandbox and a one-month credit on first invoice to reduce renewal friction. Finance ok?
Meera: finance informally ok with a small credit; will confirm exact amount. We should avoid promising more than one-month credit.
ComplianceBot: action_required: upload SOC2 attestation link: https://redwood.docs/soc2/2025-type2.pdf (automated).
Clara: provisioning note: Dedicated sandbox request queued with infra; ETA 48h once DPA signed. I can request expedited provisioning with "priority-deploy" tag.
Ethan: created calendar invite for initial call with HelixMed (they asked for end-of-day CET). I added SUP-10222 and attached the checklist.
Ben: pinging Legal: @LegalTeam can you review and sign the standard EU DPA addendum for HelixMed? Customer needs signature today to meet their procurement window.
Meera: drafting comms to customer — keep non-technical: apology, what were doing (DPA + dedicated sandbox), timeline, offer 30-min walkthrough, and a one-month credit. Posting draft below for quick edits.
Meera: "Hi Dr. Novak Thanks for flagging the residency requirement. Were sorry for the delay. We will: 1) provide a signed Data Processing Addendum covering EU-only hosting, and 2) provision a dedicated, isolated sandbox to finish your evaluation. We expect to send the signed DPA within today and to provision the sandbox within 48 hours. Wed also like to offer a one-month account credit for the inconvenience and can run a 30-minute walkthrough to complete setup. Best, Meera (Customer Success)"
Clara: LGTM. Recommend removing exact internal queue name before sending. Ben: please confirm Legal sign-off and attach DPA to the reply.
Ben: Legal replied in PM: can sign standard EU addendum, will deliver signed PDF by EOD. Ill upload to the event and to the ticket.
ComplianceBot: file_uploaded: /artifacts/dpa/helixmed_eu_dpa_signed_2026-04-04.pdf (by Ben)
Clara: filed provisioning request with infra using "priority-deploy" tag. Infra acked and set ETA 2026-04-06 16:00 CET (within 48h).
Ethan: customer confirmed they can wait for 48h if DPA is signed today. They acknowledged the calendar invite.
Meera: final comms sent at 17:12 CET. Customer replied: "Appreciate quick handling. We can continue once DPA and sandbox are in place. Thank you."
Meera: tracking items: 1) Legal sign DPA (Ben) - DONE EOD, 2) Provision Dedicated sandbox (Clara) - ETA 2026-04-06 16:00 CET, 3) Post-provision walkthrough (Meera) - scheduled, 4) Apply one-month credit on first invoice (Finance & Meera) - pending.
Ben: uploading DPA to SUP-10222 and to shared drive, confirming Legal completed sign-off.
Clara: will flip isolation checks and post-provision verification steps in SUP-10222 once infra completes.
Ethan: closing support hold for now; ticket remains open until post-provision verification. Marking account health: at-risk -> proactively mitigated.
Meera: noted renewal_risk -> moved to "priority outreach" and scheduled check-in after provisioning. Thanks team :heart:
